cues: Dilute nitric acid gives ortho and para nitrophenol.
Concentrated nitric and sulphuric acids give picric acid.
Sulphuric acid gives mainly the ortho sulphonic acid at room temperature, and mainly para at a hundred degrees.
And Friedel Crafts methylation gives the cresols.
text: The full set. Dilute nitric acid gives ortho and para nitrophenol. Concentrated nitric and sulphuric acids give picric acid. Sulphuric acid gives mainly the ortho sulphonic acid at room temperature, and mainly para at a hundred degrees. And Friedel Crafts methylation gives the cresols.
